text:
maria: CI red on master for //runtime:serve_engine_retry_test — intermittent timeout. Seen on macos-worker-7, job: https://ci.redwood.internal/1987. Failing message: "Timeout waiting for retry ack after 250ms". Started happening since the retry backoff cleanup landed yesterday. Can someone rerun and/or bisect? Repro command I used: `bazel test //runtime:serve_engine_retry_test --runs_per_test=100 --test_output=errors`

ci-bot: Rerun queued: https://ci.redwood.internal/1987/retries/1 — will post results.

liam: I'll grab this. Quick note: I can repro locally ~1/40 with `-j1`. Looks like a real-time vs mock-clock race; timers sometimes fire before the ack callback is registered.

jonah: Might be the backoff math changed in 9f2b3c — it introduces a fast-path that bypasses the timer fence. Can you try `--runs_per_test=500` or run with `--test_arg=--seed=42` to narrow randomness?

maria: Pasting small failing log snippet:
```
E 01:23:45 serve_test.go:217: expected retry ack within 250ms, got 312ms
E 01:23:45 serve_test.go:221: goroutine 45 [chan receive]:
  runtime/chan.go:123 +0x...
```
Still flaky locally.

samantha: I'll bisect in ~30-45m (heads up in case someone else starts). Suggestion: don't increase timeouts in tests as a fix; prefer deterministic clock injection or explicit sync points.

liam: Agreed — increasing RETRY_ACK_TIMEOUT to 500ms will hide the bug. If the root cause is timer registration ordering, we should add a test hook to force ordering or use a fake clock.

jonah: I can prepare a minimal repro harness that forces the race by stubbing the timer creation path. If someone posts the CI shard artifacts link I can grab full stack.

maria: ci-bot posted artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/1987/artifacts/serve_engine_retry_test.tar.gz — contains failing shard log and core dump.

ci-bot: Rerun finished: 1/3 flakes reproduced, 2 passes. See https://ci.redwood.internal/1987/runs.

samantha: Started `git bisect` now. First bad commit candidate appears to be `abc1234` (retry backoff refactor). I'll narrow down.

liam: While bisecting, can someone try `GODEBUG=schedtrace=1000` locally to get scheduler traces? Might show goroutine handoff latency. Also try `bazel test ... --test_env=MOCK_CLOCK=1` if available.

maria: Thanks everyone. If bisect lands on the refactor I'll mark the PR for revert/hotfix and open a follow-up to add fake-clock and a deterministic test. @samantha please drop updates here when you have the bisect result. :thumbsup:

samantha: Update: bisect shows first bad at `abc1234` -> I'll collect the diff and file an issue with reproducer steps. ETA ~1h.

jonah: I'll standby to review the revert PR quickly.

maria: Awesome. Leaving the local runs going and will paste any consistent repros. Thanks all.
